_comment: gateway/mcp outbound MCP server registry (issue #641, workbook-10). This is gateway/mcp's OWN declaration - it is deliberately NOT an entry in infra/feature-flags/registry.yaml, because an outbound server is a gateway surface's declaration to own. The registry-level flag lives in code as AO_MCP_OUTBOUND_ENABLED (see gateway/mcp/outbound.py, OUTBOUND_FLAG_ENV) and compiles OFF; each seeded entry also ships enabled=false, so enabling a deployment and enabling a server are two independent decisions (GR-5: new surfaces ship flag-gated OFF).

servers._note: The CTO workbook row (workbook-8, registry/prompts/modules/cto-primary.v1.yaml) references this server by ID - the id is the contract, never the endpoint, so an endpoint move is a config change rather than a prompt rewrite. The endpoint above is a DECLARED local transport name, not a URL a caller may substitute: outbound.py refuses a caller-supplied endpoint (status endpoint_override). pinnedVersion is exact - a request for any other version is refused (there is no floating fallback), and a server that answers off-pin is refused too.
